tasks.subject: Fix llama.cpp submodule "not our ref" error in ai-file-sorter
tasks.description:
Fix the "not our ref" error in the llama.cpp submodule within the ai-file-sorter repository. This involves updating the submodule to a valid upstream commit and syncing the changes through the parent repository chain.

1.  Locate the `ai-file-sorter` repository.
2.  Update the `app/include/external/llama.cpp` submodule to a valid commit (likely the latest master/main or a known stable tag).
3.  Commit and push changes to `ai-file-sorter`.
4.  Update the `ai-file-sorter` pointer in the parent repository (likely `bobfilez` or `bg` based on previous context).
5.  Verify the recursive clone.
